text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Iraqi press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraq celebrates today the ninth anniversary of the end of the 1980-1988 Iraq-Iran war.
- Iraq and China agree to enhance trade cooperation.
- Five vessels laden with foodstuffs anchored at Iraq's port of Umm Qasr.
- Deputy Prime Minister Tareq Aziz receives the Jordanian ambassador in Baghdad.
- Iraqi ruling Baath party sends delegation to India.
(The above were also carried by IRAQ)
